name: cs-research-studio
description: A multi-agent team for computer science research with human-in-the-loop gates: literature search/download/translation/reading, innovation positioning, experiment design, Linux environment setup, academic writing, and a built-in CS knowledge base.

displayDescription.en: Full CS research pipeline with human-in-the-loop: literature search, download, translation and reading; innovation positioning; experiment design and Linux environment setup; academic writing; built-in CS knowledge base.
displayDescription.zh: 计算机科研全流程：检索翻译文献、定位创新点、设计实验、配置环境、打磨论文，内置领域知识库，人在回路

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我打算研究「课题名」，请团队帮我完成从文献调研到实验设计的开题准备
defaultInitPrompt.en: I'm working on [topic]. Help my team prepare a research proposal from literature survey to experiment design.

quickPrompts.en: I'm working on [topic]. Help my team prepare a research proposal from literature survey to experiment design.
quickPrompts.zh: 我打算研究「课题名」，请团队帮我完成从文献调研到实验设计的开题准备

quickPrompts.en: Compare retrieval-augmented methods from the last three years and help me find a feasible innovation point.
quickPrompts.zh: 对比近三年的检索增强方法，帮我定位一个可落地的创新点

quickPrompts.en: Set up a PyTorch GPU experiment environment on my new Linux server and give me a reproducible environment report.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我在新的 Linux 服务器上配置 PyTorch GPU 实验环境，并输出可复现的环境说明
